name: ch22-shap
caption: SHAP weights of the honest model, coloured by the direction of each feature's effect.
live:
import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """feature,mean_abs_shap,direction,corr_value_shap,weight
n_cafe_500m,0.22676,higher value -> more suitable,0.63988,0.50074
dist_tourism,0.062667,higher value -> less suitable,-0.8115,0.13838
dist_road,0.051103,higher value -> less suitable,-0.71666,0.11285
n_tourism_500m,0.041193,higher value -> more suitable,0.60898,0.090964
n_education_500m,0.037273,higher value -> more suitable,0.53085,0.082309
dist_education,0.02216,higher value -> less suitable,-0.55847,0.048936
population,0.011691,higher value -> less suitable,-0.26535,0.025816
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_shap(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 3.4))
    cols = ["#1a9850" if r > 0.1 else "#d73027" if r < -0.1 else "#9aa5b1"
            for r in df.corr_value_shap]
    ax.barh(df.feature[::-1], df.weight[::-1], color=cols[::-1])
    ax.set_xlabel("Weight (share of mean |SHAP|)")
    ax.set_title("What the model used (green: more is better; red: less is better)",
                 loc="left", fontsize=9)
    return fig

plot_shap(df)
plt.show()
